note: The WhatsApp call, re-enacted. Taza's lines are the live platform's real answers (answers.json, 6 Nov 2026), said shorter.

lines.say: Hi Taza! Can my kids walk to school this morning?
lines.sub: Hi Taza! Can my kids walk to school this morning?

lines.say: Yes, the morning is one of the cleanest times today, around thirty-four micrograms. Avoid eight to ten in the evening: it gets close to eighty.
lines.sub: Yes: the morning is one of the cleanest times today, ≈ 34 µg/m³. Avoid 20:00–22:00, close to 80.

lines.say: А какая школа в Алматы с самым грязным воздухом?
lines.sub: Which school in Almaty has the dirtiest air?

lines.say: По исследованию AAI — школа номер сто пятьдесят шесть в Алатауском районе: семьдесят один и три десятых микрограмма за отопительный сезон.
lines.sub: AAI's study: School No. 156 in Alatau district, 71.3 µg/m³ over the heating season.

lines.say: Ал қазір қай ауданда ауа ең лас?
lines.sub: And which district has the dirtiest air right now?

lines.say: Қазір ең лас аудан — Түрксіб: PM2.5 жүз сексен сегіз микрограмм.
lines.sub: Right now the dirtiest district is Turksib: PM2.5 188 µg/m³.
